payload.summary: Ward Flow: link Movements and Delays in both directions — a per-row route to the reason a patient is stuck, not a drawer
payload.detail: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-07, in his own words: 'the instinct is I'm looking at a movement and I want to know why it's stuck. Answer that with a link on the row, not a drawer holding a whole screen. One patient's reason, in context, going to the full Delays page. There is currently no link at all between the two screens, which is the real gap.'
